title: FRAME CAPS THAT HOLD THEIR NUMBER
why: His order of 2026-10-25: I want higher frame rates to be an option, eg 75, 90, 120, 144, 240. The options were there since v28.70 but the row stepped off, 60, 30 first, so it read as if nothing went over 60, and the cap snapped to whole screen refreshes: 60 drew 48 on a 144 Hz screen, 75 and 90 drew 72. The cap now paces on due times and the row steps in plain order. Auto resolution keeps its 60 frame floor (his 2.43 a: a fast cap is no reason to shed quality).
now: Settings, display, frame cap now steps off, 30, 60, 75, 90, 120, 144, 165, 240, and each cap gives its own number of frames (show fps shows it). A cap above the screen refresh gives the screen rate.

CAP_LAST is now the time the next frame is due (0: none yet). The old test (a frame at least 1000/c-2 ms after the last) snapped to whole screen refreshes: 60 drew 48 on a 144 Hz screen, 75 and 90 drew 72, 90 drew 60 on 120 Hz. Due times step by exactly 1000/c, so the average is the cap; a frame 1 ms early is on time (stamps jitter); a frame a whole step late starts the schedule again from now, so a hitch never brings a burst. */
